preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 3 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() and len(lines[1].split()) == int(lines[0].strip()) and lines[2].strip().isdigit() and len(lines[3:]) == int(lines[2].strip())
preconditions.description: Input contains N, followed by N integers, then Q, followed by Q lines each containing one integer K.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= N <= 50 and all(1 <= x <= 1000000 for x in A) and 1 <= Q <= 10 and all(1 <= k <= 1000000 for k in queries)
preconditions.description: N, array elements, Q, and query values K satisfy the stated constraints.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == Q and all(output_lines[i] == str(sum(1 for i in range(N) for j in range(i, N) if min(A[i:j+1]) == queries[i])) for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: For each query K, the output line contains the count of subarrays where the minimum element equals K.
